tools.name: get_skarvia_info
tools.description:
What Storskarvia is and how it's positioned.

    A professional writing studio for novelists, screenwriters, and video
    scriptwriters, staffed by an AI team that fact-checks, researches, and
    tracks continuity -- but never writes the user's prose for them.

tools.name: list_features
tools.description:
The AI staff on Storskarvia and what each member actually does.

    Source: the "On staff" section of the current landing page.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description:
Current Storskarvia pricing tiers, features, and monthly fact-check quotas.

    Built from config.PLANS, the same list /pricing renders from, so this can
    no longer drift from the page the way it did while it was kept by hand.

    The founder block is read live rather than described in prose. T

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description:
Titles, slugs, and URLs of Storskarvia's evergreen craft/how-to guides.

    Reads the live GUIDES list straight from app.main (imported lazily --
    see the comment on the import below) so this can never drift out of
    sync with what's actually published at /guides.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description:
Summary and URL for one guide, looked up by slug.

    Call list_guides first to get valid slugs.

tools.name: list_my_projects
tools.description:
The authenticated user's Storskarvia projects (novels, screenplays,
    video scripts). Requires a personal Storskarvia API key as a Bearer token.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description:
Findings for one of the authenticated user's fact-check or
    continuity runs. Ownership is enforced -- a check_id belonging to
    another user raises an error rather than leaking their data.

tools.name: prepare_factcheck
tools.description:
Step 1 of a bring-your-own-agent fact-check. Fetches one of the
        authenticated user's documents (ownership enforced) plus the exact
        disclosure and method your agent MUST follow. Requires a personal
        Storskarvia API key as a Bearer token.

        After this, call ground_claim(c

tools.name: ground_claim
tools.description:
Step 2 of a bring-your-own-agent fact-check. Runs Storskarvia's own
        server-side retrieval (Wikipedia + searxng) for one claim and returns
        the sources -- no verdict, no judgment. Your agent should judge the
        claim ONLY against these returned sources, never outside knowledge.

tools.name: submit_findings
tools.description:
Step 3 of a bring-your-own-agent fact-check. Stores your agent's
        findings as a real Storskarvia Check, visible on the same findings punch
        list as a staff-run check. Requires a personal Storskarvia API key as a
        Bearer token, and ownership of `document_id` is enforced.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_guides, get_guide · Private data: list_my_projects, prepare_factcheck, ground_claim, submit_findings · Public sink: submit_findings · Destructive: submit_findings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_guides, get_guide · Private data: list_my_projects, prepare_factcheck, ground_claim, submit_findings · Public sink: submit_findings · Destructive: submit_findings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
